snippet.title: Dreams of Another Developer Interview - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Q-Games Game Director Baiyon provided an overview of Dreams of Another, the studio's upcoming shooter themed around creative destruction. It's coming to PC and PS5 on October 10.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #dreamsofanother #gamescom
